title: Store Repair Warranty and Comebacks — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Warranty clause.** A customer-pay repair performed by any store of the group under Service Accounts and Repair Orders carries the store's repair warranty for the tier's repair warranty months from its line date or the tier's repair warranty miles beyond its odometer at check-in, whichever ends first. A repeat failure of the same repair inside the repair warranty is a comeback. A comeback credit is given only when the repeat repair falls within the repair warranty of the original customer-pay repair.

**Not comebacks.** Repairs made with customer-supplied parts, damage from collision, abuse or lack of maintenance, and failures of parts the original repair did not replace are not comebacks and are billed normally.

**Counting.** Calendar months are added to the line date of the original repair; when the resulting month has no such day the warranty ends on that month's last day. The mileage limit is checked separately, against the original odometer at check-in plus the warranty miles. Both figures are read from the original repair's charge in the account's records.

**Retired clause.** The clause under which, on a comeback, the replacement parts were not billed and the labor was credited at the tier's comeback labor share as a comeback repair credit pointing at the repeat labor charge is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the comeback credit.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 12-month and 12000-mile warranty)
| Original repair | Repeat | Inside the warranty? |
|---|---|---|
| Line date 14 August, odometer 30200 | 14 August the next year, odometer 41900 | Yes — the last day and under 42200 miles |
| Line date 14 August, odometer 30200 | 15 August the next year | No — after the last day |
| Line date 29 February, odometer 30200 | 28 February the next year | Yes — that month has no 29th, so the warranty ends on its last day |
| Line date 14 August, odometer 30200 | 1 March the next year, odometer 42300 | No — beyond 42200 miles |

superseded_clauses: On a comeback the replacement parts are not billed and the labor is credited at comeback_labor_covered_pct as credit_reason comeback_repair pointing at the repeat labor row.
